summary: Iteration 48: Verified (1) Assessment-Matched 'Recommended for your board' badge on Board Transformation result page and (2) Checkout Recovery Email logic behind flag. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter48_recovery.py — 8/8 tests pass (BT recommendations all-match/no-match, DIY checkout backward-compat without token, DIY checkout with result_token persists lead_id/lead_email/lead_organization/origin_url on payment_transactions, recovery_enabled()==False, OFFER_PAGES coverage, checkout_recovery_email() template shape incl. greeting/offer name/offer link, and process_abandoned_checkouts scenarios a-e including 'sent-or-failed' for real send, 'skipped' single-email dedupe when same email already sent or has paid txn, 'untouched' for empty email and young (<60min) txn). Stripe re-check warning for fake session ids observed and tolerated as expected. Iter47 regression suite still 4/4 pass. Frontend (real browser against public URL): all-match seeded lead result page shows all 3 bt-recommended-badge-{recruit,reactivate,activate} with exact text 'Recommended for your board'; no-match lead renders 3 pathway buttons with ZERO badges; clicking bt-choose-recruit sets sessionStorage bt_result_token then navigates to /offer/recruitment which shows NO badge (verified on fresh reload — the initial query hit a React Router transition artifact); DIY button POST body to /api/payments/diy-checkout contains result_token equal to the lead's token; MongoDB payment_transactions doc verified with correct lead_email='qa-recovery-iter48-link@example.com', lead_id, lead_organization, origin_url. Stripe redirect aborted. CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_ENABLED remains false in /app/backend/.env; checkout_recovery_loop only calls process_abandoned_checkouts when recovery_enabled() is True (verified in code + unit test).
critical_code_review_comments: process_abandoned_checkouts dedupe uses `find_one({lead_email, recovery_email_status:'sent'})` per iteration; if the DB has multiple concurrent workers this is not atomic — two workers could both send. Fine for the single background loop but worth noting if scaled.

The recovery email sends via Resend to whatever SENDER_EMAIL is configured. There is no environment guard to prevent sending to real user emails during test/staging. Recommend a RECOVERY_ALLOWED_DOMAINS/RECOVERY_TEST_ONLY_RECIPIENT env safety net when CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_ENABLED flips true.

checkout_recovery_email() body embeds offer_link as plain text on its own line and build_recovery_html swaps it for an anchor. Works, but a small typo/whitespace mismatch on the template would silently render as text; consider passing the link separately.

OFFER_PAGES uses origin_url from the txn; if origin_url is missing or blank the link becomes just the path — offer_link would be '/offer/recruitment' with no host. build_recovery_html would still send a broken relative link. Add a safety default (e.g., env FRONTEND_BASE_URL) when origin_url is empty.

Frontend BoardTransformationResultPage.jsx: sessionStorage.setItem happens before navigation, but there is no cleanup after checkout success; a subsequent unrelated /offer visit would still attach the stale result_token. Consider clearing bt_result_token after successful checkout redirect or on result-page unmount.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 badge & checkout link assertions after transition-artifact clarified)

test_credentials: Public funnel — no login. QA leads created with emails prefixed 'qa-recovery-iter48-'. Seeded payment_transactions used session_id prefix 'cs_test_qa_recovery_iter48_'. All cleaned up via teardown_module.
seed_data_creation: Board-transformation leads: qa-recovery-iter48-all@example.com, qa-recovery-iter48-none@example.com, qa-recovery-iter48-link@example.com, qa-recovery-iter48-ui-all@example.com, qa-recovery-iter48-ui-none@example.com. Payment txns with prefix cs_test_qa_recovery_iter48_. teardown_module deletes both leads and txns matching qa-recovery-iter48- prefix and cs_test_qa_recovery_iter48_ prefix. Verified DB clean post-run (0 remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 48 complete: badge feature works end-to-end (backend recommendations + frontend rendering + no leakage on /offer/*), and checkout recovery pipeline behaves correctly behind CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_ENABLED=false flag. All process_abandoned_checkouts scenarios (send, dedupe-skipped, paid-skipped, empty-email-untouched, young-txn-untouched) are covered in test_iter48_recovery.py. Regression: iter47 suite still passes. When flipping the flag to true in production, add a domain safelist and clear sessionStorage.bt_result_token after purchase success.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. One transient false-positive during Playwright client-side navigation was traced to React Router transition timing (not a leak); verified with fresh navigation that /offer/recruitment cleanly renders 0 badges and contains no 'Recommended for your board' text.
